displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that analytic idealism is preferable when consciousness is treated as intrinsic reality and physical structure as its relational description, provided the theory earns its advantage through explicit constraints on boundaries, causation, and shared observation.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the selection inference by making comparative explanatory constraints, rather than mere epistemic immediacy, central to the thesis.

premises.text: Experience is directly instantiated, whereas a wholly nonexperiential intrinsic substrate is theoretically posited; an ontology that begins with instantiated experience therefore avoids one category transition, although that consideration establishes only an initial parsimony advantage.

novelty.explanation: This narrows the original parsimony claim and explicitly blocks an unsupported move from epistemic priority to metaphysical certainty.

premises.text: Physical theories principally specify relational, quantitative, and causal structure, so analytic idealism may interpret that successful structure as the public description of intrinsically experiential processes without rejecting any validated scientific prediction.

novelty.explanation: This extends the claim that idealism can preserve science by distinguishing public relational description from proposed intrinsic nature.

premises.text: Observer independence requires independence from individual observers, not independence from every possible form of mentality; external universal processes can therefore constrain multiple perspectives and support stable intersubjective correction.

novelty.explanation: This develops the transcript distinction between individual subjectivity and an external mental world into a clearer objectivity criterion.

premises.text: Dissociative boundaries should be modeled as dynamically maintained restrictions on reciprocal informational and causal access, allowing the proposal to distinguish local perspectives without treating metaphorical dissociation as a complete mechanism.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the unstable boundary concept by replacing loose analogy with an operational constraint on causal and informational accessibility.

premises.text: Intrinsic dispositions must be constrained by empirically recoverable symmetries, conservation relations, and transition rules, so universal subjectivity does not explain order merely by being assigned unspecified powers.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the schematic causal proposal by requiring its excitation dynamics to connect with independently testable structural constraints.

conclusion.text: Analytic idealism deserves conditional preference only if its experiential intrinsic basis reproduces scientific structure, yields testable boundary conditions, and explains differentiated causation with fewer unsupported primitives than neutral or nonexperiential competitors.

novelty.explanation: This conclusion preserves the pro direction while making it proportionate to unresolved comparative and mechanistic burdens.

newArguments.title: Constraint-equivalence research program
newArguments.text: Analytic idealism can convert a metaphysical proposal into a research program by requiring every successful physical constraint to have an isomorphic formulation in terms of experiential dynamics. Failure to recover a conservation law, symmetry, or intervention pattern would count against the idealist model rather than being absorbed by metaphor. This does not independently prove mentality fundamental, but it makes the view comparatively assessable and directly answers the objection that labeling the substrate mental contributes no explanatory discipline.

novelty.explanation: This is a new methodological argument proposing explicit empirical constraint equivalence as a comparative test of idealist explanatory content.

newArguments.title: Boundary degradation predictions
newArguments.text: If individual subjects are dynamically restricted regions within a wider experiential process, then graded changes in integration and reciprocal access should predict systematic changes in perspective, memory ownership, and cross-boundary influence. The relevant evidence would not establish universal consciousness by itself, but convergent boundary signatures could distinguish a disciplined dissociation model from an unrestricted metaphor. This strengthens the account by stating what successful individuation would require and by permitting observations to disfavor particular implementations.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a new predictive strategy for testing dissociative individuation rather than merely redescribing embodiment as a boundary.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that neutral monism should remain the preferred restraint position until either idealism or physicalism explains why structured representations are phenomenal, because rejecting emergence does not determine the intrinsic nature of the neutral basis.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the alternative by presenting neutrality as disciplined underdetermination rather than as an already completed ontology.

premises.text: The failure of a proposed derivation from physical quantities to experiential qualities underdetermines ontology, since idealist, dual-aspect, neutral, and primitive-law accounts remain logically available and require comparative assessment.

novelty.explanation: This extends the central underdetermination objection by explicitly identifying the remaining comparative possibility space.

premises.text: Representations can be characterized minimally as states whose causal role systematically tracks, compresses, and guides action concerning other states, without initially deciding whether their intrinsic bearer is mental or physical.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the underspecified use of representation by supplying a substrate-neutral functional characterization.

premises.text: Phenomenality should be attributed only where a representational process has integrated perspective-sensitive availability, counterfactual coherence, and temporally organized access, avoiding indiscriminate experience attribution to every informational state.

novelty.explanation: This supplies provisional qualification conditions that answer the concern that all processing might become phenomenal without discrimination.

premises.text: Any ontology must explain predictive organization, boundaries, and differentiated causation; naming the intrinsic substrate mental, physical, or neutral cannot substitute for models that yield those structures and intervention patterns.

novelty.explanation: This generalizes the explanatory demand so it applies symmetrically to neutral monism as well as to idealism.

premises.text: Selfless dreams and altered states indicate that autobiographical self-representation, ordinary spacetime organization, and phenomenal presence can vary independently, providing comparative constraints without directly settling metaphysical fundamentality.

novelty.explanation: This repairs overextension from introspective cases by treating them as discriminating constraints rather than metaphysical demonstrations.

conclusion.text: Neutral monism is warranted as a provisional framework if it specifies representation and phenomenality more precisely, applies equal explanatory standards to itself, and withholds claims about intrinsic substance until comparative evidence favors one interpretation.

novelty.explanation: This proportionate conclusion preserves the con position while acknowledging that neutrality still requires substantive representational and phenomenal criteria.

newArguments.title: Multiple intrinsic realizations
newArguments.text: Suppose identical relational and representational organization could be described consistently under mental, physical, or neutral intrinsic vocabularies while generating the same predictions. Then current evidence would not select among those intrinsic interpretations, and ontological restraint would be rationally preferable to premature identification. This argument does not show that every interpretation is equally adequate; it establishes a concrete selection burden requiring evidence that discriminates intrinsic nature rather than merely confirming shared structure.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a new underdetermination argument based on the possible predictive equivalence of competing intrinsic interpretations.

newArguments.title: Perturbational phenomenal profiles
newArguments.text: A neutral representational theory could earn content by predicting how interventions alter perspective-sensitive availability, temporal coherence, self-modeling, and reported phenomenal differentiation. Instead of equating integration with consciousness, it would compare multidimensional perturbational profiles across waking, dreaming, meditative, and disrupted states. The proposal remains neutral about intrinsic substance, but it creates empirical conditions under which particular accounts of phenomenal representation can succeed or fail and directly answers the complaint that neutrality merely postpones explanation.

novelty.explanation: This is a new empirical program using multidimensional intervention profiles to discipline a neutral account of phenomenal representation.
